title: Propagation fitted and evaluated on Brewer
fid_semantics: condition-local ordinal; HFS recordings are not paired to NoStim by fid
graph_description: four directed pairs; FF follows EC-DG-CA3-CA1-EC; feedback is reverse
burst_method: 100 ms population bins, 95th-percentile peak threshold, 300 ms separation; ±2 s lag scan with 99 circular shifts
burst_interpretation: zero-lag correlation is synchronous activity, not evidence of directed propagation; lag associations are exploratory

cv.model: pair/tunnel empirical Bayes shrinkage, strength=8 axons
cv.baseline_tunnel: pooled physical tunnel mean over eight training recordings
cv.baseline_direction_null: permutation of training axon direction labels across the eight recordings; fixed per fold
cv.direction_null_delay_note: direction permutation leaves conduction times unchanged, so its delay MAE equals the model by construction
cv.aggregation: macro mean of nine recording MAEs; FF MAE per observed tunnel, delay MAE per held-out axon
